description: This file defines the DataSpace class, which manages a collection of named data properties, including methods for accessing, modifying, and manipulating nested data structures. It also includes methods for data filtering, exporting, and interface compatibility with data objects.

classes.name: DataSpace
classes.description: A class that acts as a container for named data properties, supporting nested property access, data import/export, filtering, and interface methods for data sources.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a stored property by name.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by navigating a dot-separated path, dereferencing nested DataSpaces.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a copy of a value into a property.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Stores a value into a nested property specified by a dot-separated path, creating nested structures as needed.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a stored property by name.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Replaces current properties with a provided list.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Appends a list of properties to the current DataSpace, overwriting existing keys.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Returns a reference to the complete array of properties.

methods.name: isDataSource
methods.description: Indicates that this class implements the DataSource interface.

methods.name: getPropertyList
methods.description: Returns a list of all property keys.

methods.name: registerFilter
methods.description: Registers a filter object for transforming stored data (deprecated).

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Executes the filter's doFilter method on properties (deprecated).

methods.name: makeDataSpace
methods.description: Static method to convert a variable into a DataSpace object.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Alias for next(), used in data iteration.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Resets the DataSpace for iteration, optionally fetching the first record.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all records as an array, with options for filtering and indexing.
